Borderless Gaming is a very useful application for PC gamers, especially for those who play older or poorly optimized games. It offers a simple but effective solution by forcing borderless fullscreen mode in games that do not support it by default.

One of its biggest advantages is the convenience it provides. Faster Alt+Tab switching, easier multitasking, and better support for multiple monitors make gaming much smoother and more enjoyable. It is especially helpful for players who often switch between their game and other applications such as Discord, browsers, or music apps.

Another strong point is its compatibility with many older titles that often struggle with fullscreen settings. Features like cursor locking, automatic game profiles, and additional graphical improvements make it even more practical.

The app is easy to use and does exactly what it promises. While it may not work perfectly with every single game, for most users it significantly improves the overall gaming experience.

Overall, Borderless Gaming is a great utility tool that solves common display issues and makes PC gaming more comfortable. I definitely recommend it.

Works flawlessly!  Quick and easy to use.  I'm not a tech guru or hardcore gamer but I had this working in minutes for multiple games on multiple computers.  I honestly believe the bad reviews are due to user error, literacy issues, and/or tech problems on their end.  I have found this to be the perfect solution for indie, retro, and modern games that don't have a native full screen option.  I don't know how much easier it could be.

I've never bought a non-game tool in steam, and almost didn't buy this due to the negative reviews, but I'm so glad I didn't listen to them as this app is great.  I've tried multiple alternatives but this is by far the best one, totally worth the money.  Can be used for games launched both with and without steam, has a dark mode, easy setup for game profiles, multiple options for removing borders, upscaling, visual effects, etc. It does so much more than I was expecting yet remains easy to use if you just want it for borderless gaming.  

I've only had one game where the title bar wasn't automatically removed, so guess what I did, instead of leaving an unjustified ♥♥♥♥♥♥ review I used my brain and a minimal amount of critical thinking. I just went into that game's settings, found a pixel cropping option, cropped 25 pixels from the top of the game window, and the title bar was removed perfectly. The entire process took all of 20 seconds, involved opening one menu, and typing two number keys; if this simple process proves too complicated for anyone, they probably shouldn't be gaming, or even going outside alone, and probably should be wearing a helmet at all times.  It's so frustrating and misleading to see bad reviews left for good products due to consumer incompetence...but I digress...

TLDR/Bottom Line: This app does exactly what it says and more.  I don't know how much easier or intuitive this could be, don't waste your time messing around with MS powertoys, autohotkey, etc., like I did; just spend the 6 bucks on BG and save yourself the headache, you'll thank me later.
